blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Some 600 soldiers took part in a four-day joint military exercises in Dinagat Islands starting Thursday, October 22, a drill designed to test and improve the readiness of troops and local authorities on combat scenarios and man-made disasters. Spearheaded by the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ (AFP) Eastern Mindanao Command (EastMinCom), the war games, dubbed “Exercise Surigao Sentinel 01-2026,” will involve live-fire tests, troop movements, and war game maneuvers across key staging areas in the province.
